hooks.name: Keep README and Kiro write-up in sync
hooks.description: At the end of each agent turn, note what changed so the README and KIRO_USAGE log stay accurate for judges.

action.prompt: If this turn added or changed a user-facing feature, update the Features section of README.md. Append one dated line to docs/KIRO_USAGE_LOG.md describing which Kiro feature was used (spec task, steering, hook, MCP, property test) and what it produced. Keep it short; skip if nothing user-facing changed.
